records.task_suite: DG1001 local-agentic-coding-128gb: four Python coding tasks / 86 hidden tests
caveats: One run for this exact pairing; the source explicitly warns that one run is not a measurement of fine-grained ranking.
All tasks are small self-contained Python repositories, not large unfamiliar production codebases.
This quantized single-node setup is not the same Variant as the official DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 mixed checkpoint used in 2xGB10 evidence.
Wall-clock and E2E throughput must not be compared with other harnesses or this repository's Formal100 contract.
records.notes: Strong external signal that a heavily compressed DeepSeek V4 lane can complete a real tool/edit/test loop on one GB10; does not qualify first-party production quality.

records.task_suite: DG1001 local-agentic-coding-128gb: four Python coding tasks / 86 hidden tests
caveats: One run in the DG1001 hidden-test suite; do not treat 86/86 as a stable probability estimate.
The external suite is four small Python tasks and does not establish large-repository or 384K/512K production fitness.
Laguna serving behavior is runtime-sensitive: public GB10 reports document tool-call breakage on older vLLM and deep-prefill hard-hang risks with unsafe DFlash settings.
Reported E2E throughput is source-contract-specific and not comparable to this repository's Formal100 tok/s.
records.notes: Material P0 single-GB10 coding candidate: strong model-side agentic signal plus mature GB10 serving recipes, but first-party quality/context/recovery gates remain required.

records.task_suite: DG1001 local-agentic-coding-128gb: four Python coding tasks / 86 hidden tests
caveats: Two consecutive 86/86 runs are materially stronger repeat evidence than a single pass, but still only four small Python tasks.
This Q3_K_XL GGUF is a separate Variant from RadixArk NVFP4 and official FP8; its quality/performance evidence must not be transferred between variants.
Configured context was 65,536 in these coding runs, so this result does not establish 256K/384K/512K coding fitness.
The two wall clocks were 33:33 and 38:24; a single wall-clock value is intentionally omitted.
records.notes: One of the strongest external single-GB10 agentic-coding replication signals found in this audit; should be a P0 first-party replication candidate.

records.task_suite: DG1001 local-agentic-coding-128gb: repeated four-task hidden-test study
caveats: These two back-to-back runs use the Java/jaja harness and therefore must not be merged numerically with the separate opencode 86/86 run.
One run lost an entire task because the harness accepted a four-token STOP with zero tool calls; the source explicitly identifies this as a harness gap.
The pair demonstrates that run-level outcome is a property of Model × Harness × Sample, not a stable scalar model score.
records.notes: Retained as repeatability/harness evidence. It is a warning against ranking models by a single perfect run.
